text: As I stand here, the clinical glass walls and institutional fixtures contrast with the bold, colorful displays inside. My curiosity is piqued; there is an inviting pull from the R+D exhibit, promising reflections on research, innovation, and perhaps the intersection between humanity and technology. I feel oddly suspended between sterile order and creative dynamism, aware of my own presence as both observer and participant. There’s an anticipation humming in the air—a sense that ideas are being shaped and I am here on the threshold, ready to engage with them.
